text: Special Technique: Identifying and Breaking ROT-2 Obfuscation

Cybersecurity mein jab koi string <highlight>Base64</highlight> jaisi dikhay par decode na ho, toh aksar us par <highlight>Caesar Cipher (ROT)</highlight> apply kiya gaya hota hai. ROT-2 ka matlab hai ke alphabet ko 2 positions aagay shift kiya gaya hai (A banta hai C, B banta hai D).
Step 1: How to Spot ROT-2 (Pattern Matching)
Standard Base64 prefixes ko target string se compare karein. Agar difference hamesha <highlight>2 letters</highlight> ka hai, toh yeh confirm ROT-2 hai.
Alphabet ko 2 positions peeche lane ke liye hum <highlight>tr</highlight> (translate) utility use karte hain. Hum system ko batate hain ke 'c' se start hone wali series ko 'a' se map karein.

code:
# Full Chain: ROT-2 Translate then Base64 Decode
echo "VjJodmNITnBaU0JrWVdsemVRbz0K" | tr 'c-za-bC-ZA-B' 'a-zA-Z' | base64 -d

# Result: Whoopsie daisy

title: Pro-Tips for Future Challenges
items: Padding Check: Agar end mein '=' hai toh hamesha Base64 check karein.
Manual Shift: Agar standard tools fail hon, toh pehle 3 letters ka manual alphabet count check karein.
Automation: CyberChef mein 'ROT13' recipe use karke 'Amount' ko 2 set karne se bhi yeh solve ho jata hai.
